title: Clone()
summary: Creates a full copy of an instance and its descendants — unparented. Archivable=false instances are skipped. The returned copy must be parented to appear.

reference.returns: A deep copy with Parent = nil. Internal welds/constraints are re-wired within the copy.

details.heading: Archivable
details.body: Any descendant with Archivable = false is omitted from the clone (that's also what publishing uses).

details.heading: What is NOT cloned
details.body: Script runtime state isn't carried over meaningfully; player-owned transient state, event connections made at runtime by OTHER scripts don't transfer.

explanation.whatItIs: Photocopy, then place. Templates live in storage; clones enter the world.
explanation.whyItExists: Prefabs: design once, spawn many — enemies, pickups, projectiles.
whenNotToUse: When you need a DIFFERENT class — build fresh with Instance.new
Cloning huge trees every frame — pool instead
tips: Clone → tweak (name, position, attributes) → parent LAST (single replication event)
Rename clones! Identical names in one container confuse FindFirstChild
Keep templates Archivable and non-simulating (Anchored, CanCollide) until spawned
commonMistakes: Forgetting to parent the clone — it exists but nowhere
Accidentally cloning scripts that immediately re-run side effects
Archivable=false somewhere in the template → pieces silently missing

examples.title: Template spawner
examples.code:
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local template = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("EnemyGoblin")

local function spawnEnemy(position: Vector3)
    local enemy = template:Clone()
    enemy.Name = "Goblin_" .. tostring(task.getId())
    enemy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))
    enemy.Parent = workspace.Enemies     -- appears NOW
    return enemy
end
